resolved_findings.issue: Cache reuse checks exit zero without requiring reason null; output cap rejection with exit zero may be reused.
Compilation permits nonempty output although production compilation requires silence; enforce silence and bind that policy in cached results.
Replay/audit caches not bound to actual compiled artifact digest inventory; regenerated binaries can incorrectly reuse earlier replay. Policy helper cache must also bind actual audit log.
Tool binary hashes omit imported toolchain library inputs and inherited Lean environment overrides; bind library content identity and controlled environment before reusing evidence.

Compilation now refuses any nonempty output; this is at least as strict as production trim-based silence.
Compile cache binds earlier compiled inputs; replay and Lean audit bind complete resulting artifact inventory including companion files. Audit-policy helper additionally binds audit-log digest.
All toolchain library file hashes, Python executable, Lean/checker executables, helper, runner, source manifest and retained receipt enter cache identity.
Child environment restricted to recorded LEAN_PATH/PATH/LANG/LC_ALL/HOME.
Expected compiled-file union must exactly equal actual build-tree file inventory before replay.

limitations: Source review only; no Lean processes or production tests executed by reviewer.
